dimensions.rationale: All seven stop criteria are assessed with substance, each tied to specific project state: goal_alignment references the will's direct statement and census corroboration; repository_breadth names FamilySearch, Ancestry, MyHeritage, and explains why naturalization is low value-add; original_substitution cites specific FamilySearch images and Ancestry derivative confirmation; independent_verification distinguishes census household inference (same method, same informant class) from the will (different record type, different informant); evidence_class identifies the will as original/primary; conflict_resolution states no conflicts recorded; overturn_risk acknowledges the destroyed death certificate as a verified loss and notes no accessible record type remains unsearched. Each criterion is a 1–2 sentence assessment grounded in log entries or project state, not generic boilerplate.
